companies_siren_unique.name: companies_siren_unique

missions_company_required_check.value: ("missions"."project_id" is null and "missions"."ticket_id" is null) or "missions"."company_id" is not null

missions_task_project_check.name: missions_task_project_check
missions_task_project_check.value: "missions"."task_id" is null or "missions"."project_id" is not null

time_entries_company_required_check.name: time_entries_company_required_check
time_entries_company_required_check.value: ("time_entries"."project_id" is null and "time_entries"."ticket_id" is null and "time_entries"."contract_id" is null) or "time_entries"."company_id" is not null

time_entries_task_project_check.name: time_entries_task_project_check
time_entries_task_project_check.value: "time_entries"."task_id" is null or "time_entries"."project_id" is not null

tickets_open_incident_unique.name: tickets_open_incident_unique

direct_costs_company_required_check.name: direct_costs_company_required_check

documents_company_required_check.name: documents_company_required_check
documents_company_required_check.value: ("documents"."project_id" is null and "documents"."contract_id" is null and "documents"."site_id" is null and "documents"."ticket_id" is null and "documents"."quote_id" is null) or "documents"."company_id" is not null

appointments_company_required_check.name: appointments_company_required_check
